description: Bounded isotropic refine/coarsen adaptation of 3-D octree leaves around a spherical source with one-level face/edge balancing.

source.title: Unstructured Adaptive NAS Parallel Benchmark, Version 1.0

input.leaf_record: level plus aligned lower-corner integer coordinates; side length is 2^(2-level)
input.input_mesh: leaves cover the domain exactly without overlap; face- and edge-neighbor levels differ by at most one

contract.operation: adapt one explicit cubic leaf mesh to a spherical moving heat-source center
contract.overlap: squared distance from source center to its nearest point in a cell is strictly less than radius squared
contract.refinement: split every source-overlapping cell isotropically into eight children, recursively to level two
contract.balance: refine coarse cells as needed until face- and edge-neighbor levels differ by at most one
contract.coarsening: merge all eight children only when the parent does not overlap the source and the merge preserves the face/edge level constraint; repeat until no merge is possible
contract.output_checksum: sort leaves by (level,z,y,x); sum (i+1)*(1000*level+100*x+10*y+z), with zero-based i
contract.complexity: bounded O(leaf_count^3) pairwise topology work with at most 64 leaves

output.definition: position-weighted checksum of the final canonical leaf mesh
